subject: Export-all and assistant data: chats (Aegra checkpoints) and memories (Aegra store) are not in the export
body:
S14 lands assistant_threads (0030). Your export picks up its rows automatically: id, title, page_ref and timestamps, since authenticated can select it.

Not covered:
1. The chat contents. These are the Aegra thread checkpoints, server-only tables, read through the host's checkpointer.
2. Approved memories. These live in the Aegra store, namespace ("memories", user_id).

I can provide an async function for your builder to call, so the export reads assistant data through the right path without touching Aegra tables:
naadi_api.assistant.export.collect(user_id) -> {threads: [{id, title, messages: [{role, text, at}]}], memories: [{key, fact, created_at}]}
Do you want that, and which area/file name should it use? I'll ship it as a follow-up on the shared branch once you confirm.
